comparison.objective: Orient an 18650 cell into a spot welder and latch its lid; unrelated to damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Cell extraction, reorientation, close-fit placement, welder stabilization, and lid latching. It shares bimanual stabilization only as a generic primitive.
comparison.success_condition: Correct-polarity cell seated, lid caught, welder reoriented and released safely. The body supplies the rubric; no separate spec version is present.
comparison.reason: Tests polarity-aware insertion and latching, not iterative mechanical tuning or post-adjustment dynamic behavior.
